articleBodyHtml:
Creative Process and Project Completion

The streamer discusses the difficulty of letting go of a project once the decision to stop working on it has been made. They mention that if they know they won't release something, they tend to give up quickly, as they feel it would be a waste of time otherwise.

They also reflect on the importance of personal perception, stating that even after releasing something, their own view of it remains unchanged, regardless of others' opinions.
